critic_extra.impact_on_owner_goal: Owner detachment means the OS becomes the company's highest-value credential store with nobody watching it. critic_strengths: The one-registry-three-classes law itself (gates/registry.yaml header + scripts/gate-registry-lint.mjs merge-blocking): forcing every gate to carry an explicit required/adapted/n_a entry for every class makes silent absence structurally impossible — 'nobody decided the absence' can never recur. Its custody and versioning are the flaw (confirmed by other findings); its content is not.

gates/class-map.yaml policy composition: fail-closed unknowns (unknown = full battery, never a default), add/adapt-only overlays that can tighten but never soften, and honest 'owner ratification pending' markers instead of guessed dimension values.
